config.documentTitleFull: PETITION FOR NOTATION OF CLEARANCE AFTER A WRONGFUL ARREST OR CHARGE PURSUANT TO A.R.S. § 13-4051
config.courtCaption: IN THE SUPERIOR COURT OF THE STATE OF ARIZONA

primaryStatutoryAuthority.description: Any person wrongfully arrested, indicted, or otherwise charged may petition the superior court for an order entering a notation on all court, police and agency records that the person has been cleared, with accompanying justification, plus an order that agencies not release copies except on court order.

This remedy is different from sealing. A person with notice of the order who fails to comply is liable in damages.

provenance.registryExcerpt: Any person wrongfully arrested, indicted, or otherwise charged may petition the superior court for an order entering a notation on all court, police and agency records that the person has been cleared, with accompanying justification, plus an order that agencies not release copies except on court order. The statute creates a participant-initiated petition in superior court. Venue: Statewide Arizona law; petition in superior court. Destination: Superior court — a hearing is contemplated by the statute, and the judge issues the order if the judge believes justice will be served. Rules: fees, fee waiver, service and notarization are each recorded as not stated in the source review. Packet instruction: Explain that this remedy is different from sealing.
